title: Monicity of the concrete binary submodule inclusion
statement: For any scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], opens $W,V$, module sheaves $H$ on $X$ and $Q$ on $V$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and a monomorphism $\iota:Q\to H|_V$, the first projection $\varphi$ of [def-weil-pbc-module-binary-submodule-pullback] is a monomorphism. No quasi-coherence, finite type or overlap condition is needed.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PF (lemma-extend), binary gluing paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PF

proof.text: Direct image is a right adjoint, hence preserves monomorphisms; transport by an isomorphism also preserves monicity. The first pullback projection of this monomorphism is mono. Lean proves this by adjunction and pullback instances.

proof_origin.note: Concrete Lean implementation of the cited gluing paragraph; local properties also follow Definitions 01BE and 01B5, read on the Stacks website.

mathlib_searches.query: Restriction to an open of the pullback of a module sheaf along the direct image of a submodule
Quasi coherence and finite type of sheaves of modules are local on a cover of two opens

from.place: Affine-union construction: binary submodule gluing; Monicity of the concrete binary submodule inclusion

instance binarySubmoduleInclusion_mono (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (Q : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
    (ι : Q ⟶ H.over V) [Mono ι] :
    Mono (binarySubmoduleInclusion X W V H Q ι)
